nodes.name: 01-business-operations.md
nodes.summary: Catalog of 26 business operation categories mapping actors to commands in the pet care multi-tenant SaaS platform. Covers authentication, appointments, walk-ins, veterinary services, inventory, billing, and more across Platform, Organization, Store, and Customer scopes.
nodes.languageNotes: Bilingual Vietnamese-English technical documentation with tabular command mappings for all 11 actors including Platform Admin, Organization Admin, StoreManager, Receptionist, Veterinarian, Groomer, InventoryStaff, FinanceStaff, Customer, Caregiver, and System.

nodes.name: 02-business-rules.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive business rules catalog with 369 rules across 25 categories defining invariants, state transition guards, and scope constraints. Includes detailed formulas for inventory concurrency, refund eligibility windows, and cross-store medical record consent protocols.
nodes.languageNotes: Technical specification with formal rule IDs (RULE-01-01 through RULE-25-06), mathematical formulas for inventory reservation and refund calculations, and scope-based constraint definitions.

nodes.name: 03-state-machines.md
nodes.summary: Finite State Machine specifications for 16 domain aggregates including Account, Store, Appointment, Order, Invoice, Payment, Refund, Membership, Package, and Grooming. Documents 16 cross-aggregate event bridges with Transactional Outbox Pattern architecture for consistency.
nodes.languageNotes: FSM diagrams in ASCII format with command-to-command transitions, guard conditions (RULE-ID references), domain events, and terminal state definitions. Includes Transactional Outbox Pattern guidelines for cross-aggregate consistency.
